title: Redline Snap row stops cutting Edges and centers
goal: In the redline properties panel, the Snap setting reads "Edges and centers" but the last letter is sliced off. This makes the setting readable at the panel's normal width.
notes:
redline.html Tool options section. Measured 2026-08-23 at the 267px dock: the .lead gets 102px for 104px of content, so it clips by 2px with no ellipsis (flex + overflow:hidden hard-cuts). Two-item row, no trailing action, so .irow.stacked and .irow.wide are both heavier than the problem. Proven dead end: you cannot make the 76px label track yield to the value in CSS grid. minmax(0,76px) on the label plus min-width:max-content on the value overflows the row in Chrome (label stays 76, select grows to 126, row total 255.6 vs 232); min(max-content,100%) resolves to 100% and changes nothing; fit-content(76px) works but shrinks the label to 27px and breaks the label column alignment with the neighbouring rows. So the fix is either a shorter value string or a per-section label width.

RESOLVED 2026-08-23: the premise was wrong. The squeeze was not the value, it was the label column. Every label in the Properties dock is under 28px, so 76px was 48px of waste per row. .irow now takes --rl-w (default 76px) and redline's Properties .dgrp-b sets 44px, which fixes the Snap value AND the Show segment together and keeps every row aligned. Files: shared/components/inspector.css, pages/redline.html.
acceptance: At the default panel width the Snap value reads in full, with nothing cut off
The Snap row still lines up with the Units and Show rows above and below it
The row is measured in a browser at the default panel width before and after, and the numbers are recorded in the task log

log.note: Adversarial review before building. The task notes framed this as a two-item row that had to be squeezed, and offered a shorter value string or a per-section label width. Both accept the 76px label column as given. Measured every row in the Properties dock at its 264px default: the widest label ANYWHERE in the panel is 'Show' at 27.4px (Units 26.1, Snap 25.4, Role 21.9, Label 27.3, Color 27.0). The column is 76px. So 48px a row is dead air, and the value was being starved by a column sized for labels this panel does not have.
Same measurement pass found a second clipped control nobody had reported: the Show segment needs 155px for All/Size/Spacing and gets 144px. One fix covers both.

BEFORE, Chrome at 1200px viewport, dock 264px, row 232px: label track 76px, gap 12px, select 144px, .lead slot 102px for 103.7px of text -> hard-cut with no ellipsis (text-overflow does nothing on a flex container). Screenshot queue/audits/2026-08-23-redline-snap-before.png.

Fix: inspector.css .irow / .irow.split now read grid-template-columns:var(--rl-w,76px) ..., so the label column is a knob with the old value as its default (no other page sets it, so nothing else moves). redline.html sets --rl-w:44px on the Properties .dgrp-b, i.e. on the whole panel rather than one section, so every row narrows together and the controls stay in one column. Documented in the CSS with the measurements and with 'set it on the panel, never on a row'.

AFTER, same conditions: label track 44px on all six rows, every control starts at x=926, select 174px, .lead slot 134px for 103.7px of text -> 30.3px headroom, not clipped. Show segment 176px, no button clipped. Role segment 176px, no button clipped. Verified in the light theme too (slot 104px, need 104px, not clipped). Shots: -snap-after.png, -props-lower.png, -snap-light.png.

Review of the built thing: swept all 45 mock pages that use .select in a hidden iframe. redline.html is clean. Eight other pages still hard-slice a dropdown value ('Brand / gradient' 111px in 94px on app-shell/draw-boolean/dsys/editor/paint/typography, 'Semantic / Good' 113px in 94px on states, 'Button' 56px in 45px on lang-sections). That is the design-system epic, staged next not now, so it is written into the audit's rough list rather than queued.

Left alone deliberately: the Color row two sections down is .irow.split.stacked from an earlier task because it could not fit inline. With --rl-w:44px it now fits with 8px to spare. Un-stacking would quietly reverse a decision the user has not reviewed, so it is an evaluate question in the audit instead. shared checks pass (check-elevation, check-states, check-selection); page 200s with no console errors beyond the pre-existing favicon 404.

The redline Properties panel's label column went from 76px to 44px (--rl-w on the panel), so Snap reads 'Edges and centers' in full with 30.3px of headroom and the Show segment stopped clipping. Measured in Chrome at the 264px default dock, before and after, in both themes; shared mock checks pass. Audit: queue/audits/2026-08-23-redline-snap-row.json. Commit 2973457.
